findings.title: Reject committed JSON symlinks before source verification
findings.problem: ls-tree --name-only discards mode. Git symlinks (120000) are blobs, so the existing cat-file blob check accepts them and hashes their link text. On checkout, worker file reads follow the symlink and return different bytes; the claimed verified input is not the source consumed by the worker. Recursive prior-resolution symlinks also differ from normal entry.isFile() inventory behavior.

independentRealGitReproduction.steps: Restore ordinary fixture commit in isolated test repo, replace visible002source with symlink to003.json, update only that manifest fingerprint, commit symlink+manifest, call actual loadPreparedDossiers at that full immutable commit. It returns1source-verified dossier; assert filesystem source bytes fingerprint differs from verified raw link fingerprint.

Add real-Git source/extraction/prior symlink negatives and keep existing nonblob/omission negatives reaching their intended branches.
